text:
alex_chang: heads up — rolled a firewall tighten in ap-south ~5m ago, default-deny on L7 for outbound to keystore. seeing a spike in GPU node join failures (warm pool). 😬
infra-bot: rollout completed: firewall-ap-south v2 -> default-deny egress L7 (rule IDs: fw-2026-71).
maria_k: confirmed — control-plane logs show a flurry of 403s from warm-pool instances hitting keystore proxy (sigv4 handshake failures). sample: `ERR KMS_SIGN: 403 Forbidden`
samir_w: any automatic retry/backoff? nodes try join, then die and get reprovisioned? that's the cost loop we fear.
oncall_jess: alerting SRE oncall — I'm on it, will look at reprovision rate and eviction logs.
alex_chang: reprovision numbers: warmpool evicts ~30% of attempts in last 10m, region prewarm capacity down ~12 GPUs. provisioning autoscale triggered additional spot launches -> cost bump estimated +18% for the hour.
maria_k: firewall rule is doing deep packet inspection for SNI->keystore-proxy; older nodes are using legacy TLS handshake pattern that gets blocked. we can either whitelist keystore FQDNs, open SNI passthrough, or add an exception for the warmpool subnet.
samir_w: quick mitigation: add temporary egress allow for `keystore.internal.ap-south.redwood:443` from warmpool tag. low blast radius and fast.
alex_chang: worried about audit/compliance window — adding whitelist reduces audit log visibility for egress evaluation. Compliance asked us to avoid host-level exceptions.
maria_k: right — but we can implement a targeted exception with enhanced packet capture to keep audit trail. compromise: whitelist + enable sampling=100% for flowlogs for that subnet for 1h.
oncall_jess: I'm seeing the sampling toggle in the control-plane console. If we enable 100% sampling we hit log ingestion and retention costs — estimate +$250 for the hour in S3/ingest for ap-south. still cheaper than the reprovision delta.
samir_w: alternative: enable SNI passthrough on fw (no whitelist). config change is a single boolean on the cluster, but needs a small test — might be safer for audit but config rollout takes ~15m.
alex_chang: decision call? we need something in <10m to stop churn.
maria_k: I'm +1 for whitelist-on-tag + 100% flowlog sampling for 1h. then follow up with a proper fw config to enable SNI passthrough and rotate legacy client certs.
oncall_jess: taking action: creating exception rule now and flipping sampling.
oncall_jess: `acl add allow egress warmpool-tag keystore.internal.ap-south.redwood:443 --note "temp hotfix 1719944444"`
infra-bot: ACL change applied (rule fw-exc-1719944444). flowlog-sampling(ap-south-warmpool)=100% for 60m.
alex_chang: seeing immediate drop in join failures, reprovision rate back to baseline. documenting in runbook.
maria_k: follow-ups: 1) change fw cluster to SNI passthrough + test in staging, 2) onboard newer keystore client with TLS fix to nodes, 3) review audit retention vs cost and propose a 30d/90d split for flowlog archives.
samir_w: for the cost papertrail: please capture the delta: reprovision-cost vs sampling-cost vs whitelist-risk. I'll model tonight.
oncall_jess: created incident stub: INC-2026-APFW with links to ACL change and flowlog snapshot. tagging security and compliance. :white_check_mark:
alex_chang: thanks all — great fast run. we'll keep exception in place until SNI passthrough validated (ETA 8h).
maria_k: adding a short postmortem note to the infra channel once we have the full cost numbers and root cause.
infra-bot: scheduled job: auto-remove fw-exc-1719944444 at 1719952044 unless extended.
